requirement:
Every `habeas author` form MUST accept `--missing` and `--force`, which are
mutually exclusive; `--missing` MUST be the default. Under `--missing`, the
command MUST assess only the selected subjects whose evidence is missing, stale,
or invalid, and MUST preserve every current record without invoking a model,
including accepted FIXME judgments and current false judgments; a current false
judgment is reassessed only when its subject or inputs change or `--force` is
given. Under `--force`, the command MUST assess every selected subject. `--stdout`
MUST imply `--force`, because it writes no evidence. The command MUST report the
number of selected subjects it skipped as current. When no assessment is needed,
the command MUST succeed without resolving model configuration or credentials.
rationale:
I found no gap against `requirements.authoring.refresh`. Each obligation maps to code and a test.

**Flags.** `src/main.rs#enum[Command]` (the `Author` variant) declares `--missing` and `--force`. `missing` conflicts with `force` and `stdout`, so the pair is mutually exclusive. One `Author` command serves every form, so every form accepts both flags. `--missing` is the default because it is simply `force == false`.

**`--missing` selects only subjects whose evidence is missing, stale or invalid.**
- `src/authoring/batch.rs#fn[select_subjects]` skips a definition, citation review or site review when `!force && current(..)`.
- `src/authoring/batch.rs#fn[current]` treats `Valid`, `Fixme` and `DeterminationFalse` as current. Missing, stale and invalid states are selected.
- `src/authoring/batch.rs#fn[subject_is_current]` does the same for one named subject, and also reflects FIXME records made stale by a closed issue.

**Current records are preserved without a model.** Current records are never selected, so no model runs and the files are untouched. This includes accepted FIXME records and current false judgments. A false judgment is reassessed only once it is no longer in the `DeterminationFalse` state, which means its subject or inputs changed. `--force` reassesses it.

**`--force` assesses every selected subject.** `main` passes `force` into `AuthoringOptions`. `select_subjects` then selects everything, and `src/authoring/mod.rs#fn[author_evidence_with_options]` skips its currency check.

**`--stdout` implies `--force`.** `author_evidence_with_options` computes `force = options.force || Stdout`.

**The skipped count is reported.**
- Batches print "N authored; M skipped as current; K failed" from `src/main.rs#fn[main]`, using `BatchOutcome.unchanged`.
- A single current subject prints "...evidence is current; 1 skipped as current (use --force to reassess)".

**No configuration or credentials are resolved when nothing needs assessment.**
- `src/authoring/batch.rs#fn[run_batch]` returns early on an empty `subjects` before `config::resolve_authoring`.
- `author_evidence_with_options` returns `Ok(None)` before `configured_assessment`.

**Tests.** All carry `{test}` references to the subject.
- `tests/authoring_batch.rs#fn[missing_keeps_current_records_and_force_reassesses_every_selected_subject]` covers:
  - the default and explicit `--missing` for a named subject, the `author-evidence` alias and `--all`, all run with a corrupt config to prove no configuration resolution
  - mutual exclusion of `--missing` and `--force`, and of `--missing` and `--stdout`
  - `--force`
  - `--stdout` invoking the model
  - `--all --force` reporting "6 authored; 0 skipped as current"
- `fn[batch_fills_evidence_preserves_current_records_and_reauthors_only_changed_inputs]` covers a preserved accepted FIXME record and a stale subject reassessed alone, with "1 authored; 5 skipped as current".
- `fn[batch_preserves_current_false_judgments_and_reauthors_stale_ones]` covers a current false judgment kept and a stale one reauthored.
- `fn[batch_reauthors_a_false_judgment_when_its_reference_set_changes]` covers a false judgment reauthored after a reference-set change.
- `fn[site_reviews_are_authored_by_requirement_and_orphans_deleted_by_all]` and `fn[batch_authors_citation_reviews_and_preserves_current_ones]` cover the site and citation forms, with and without `--missing`, with a corrupt config and no model call.

**Borderline point.** A single-subject run that actually assesses the subject prints no skipped count. I treated this as within the text, since nothing was skipped.
